title: Gibson SG Standard '61 Stop Bar, Miami Pink, Exclusive

long_description.title: The Classic SG for any generation, now in two limited, Miami-inspired colors
long_description.body:
As we celebrate the opening of the Gibson Garage in Miami, Florida, Gibson is proud to introduce the SG Standard ’61 in two new Miami-inspired finishes: Miami Pink and Miami Blue. These vibrant new colors were inspired by the colors of local Miami sports teams and reflect South Florida’s vibrant spirit and rich culture. Available in limited quantities, they’re sure to go fast, so don’t wait. 




The SG Standard ‘61 returns to the classic design that made it relevant, played, and loved – shaping sound across generations and genres of music. In 1961, the Les Paul™ model was put on hiatus, and an all-new design evolved into what is today known as the SG™ or “solid guitar.” The Gibson SG Standard ‘61 retains the styling of the legendary original models from the early 1960s. It features a solid mahogany body with the classic double-cutaway SG shape, complete with the iconic deeply sculpted body scarfing and double horns that make this model instantly identifiable. 




The mahogany neck has a fast-playing SlimTaper™ profile and is capped with a bound rosewood fretboard that is equipped with 22 medium jumbo frets and acrylic trapezoid inlays. The fretboard has a 12” radius, so it’s comfortable for first-position chords, and lead lines played higher up the neck won’t fret out. The neck joins the body at the 22nd fret, ensuring easy access to its entire length, making the SG an ideal guitar for lead players. As with the earliest SG models, the SG Standard ’61 features a 5-ply teardrop-shaped pickguard. The nickel-plated hardware includes a classic-style ABR-1 Tune-O-Matic™ bridge and aluminum Stop Bar tailpiece that help contribute to the model’s excellent sustain. 




The SG Standard ’61 is equipped with smooth-turning Vintage Deluxe tuners with Keystone buttons and has a GraphTech® nut. The pair ensures rock-solid tuning stability. The pickups are 60s Burstbucker™ humbuckers™ for a classic voice with added power and top end. The two-volume and two-tone controls feature audio taper potentiometers and are hand-wired with Orange Drop® capacitors. The controls are capped with black Top Hat knobs. The SG Standard ’61 delivers the legendary SG tone, outstanding playability, and American-made Gibson quality that have made the SG the choice of countless players around the world for decades. A Gibson hardshell case is also included.




The Gibson SG Standard ’61 in Miami Blue and Miami Pink are available exclusively at the Gibson Garage Miami location and online at Gibson.com and only for a limited time, so grab yours while they’re still available.
